card.name: Estrogen and hormone-therapy wording
card.fires_on: Small words or word pieces right after estrogen terms or in women's hormone-therapy text, such as "in" after unopposed estrogens or endometrial cancer, "[" after conjugated estrogen (CE), and the middle of "menopause".

modes.label: Linking word after estrogen
modes.description: The word "in" right after estrogen use or endometrial cancer, before "women" or "a woman with a uterus".
modes.example: The use of unopposed estrogens<< in>> women with intact uteri has been associated

modes.label: Inside hormone-related words
modes.description: Partway through words like menopause, estrogens or anabolic in hormone contexts.
modes.example: DUAVEE contains conjugated<< est>>rogens and bazedoxifene

modes.label: Bracket after estrogen abbreviation
modes.description: An opening bracket holding a dose after conjugated estrogen (CE).
modes.example: daily oral conjugated estrogen (CE)<< [>>0.625 mg] combined

card.writes: It suppresses the word hormone and its variants, so it seems to stop the model from repeating "hormone" where the text is already about estrogens.
card.plain: It lights up in estrogen and menopause text on small words where the next word should not be "hormone".
